deck.title: 63 is a game about guessing cards
deck.text: Teams compete to see who can score the most points.
deck.info: Every game generates a brand-new deck with cards from various packs.

example_card.title: An example card
example_card.description: Just an example. Real cards are people, films and things to guess. And they usually have a second line of description with a fun fact or a little joke.

example_card_2.title: A blur on the screen
example_card_2.description: Gone before you could read it, right? I hate when that happens, I could've sworn there was something there!

example_card_3.title: Another example card
example_card_3.description: You weren't meant to read this one. But since you did, let me know what you thought.

example_card_4.title: Did you catch that?
example_card_4.description: No? It went by a bit too fast. What was it? Nobody knows, but maybe it was important.

example_card_5.title: A funny card
example_card_5.description: The funniest card ever written, yet no one will read it because it flies by so fast. Ironic, isn't it?

cards.title: Each card represents a concept
cards.text: This could be anything from historical figures to pop culture references
cards.info: A card only counts if its full title is said, in the right order.
cards.more_info:
Each card has a short description to help if you don't know the concept. Use it as a starting point for your clues, but don't just read it out.

It's your game, so be as strict or relaxed with the rules as you like.

default_card.title: Home Alone
default_card.description: A 1990 comedy film starring Macaulay Culkin that follows a left behind child fending off burglars from his family residence.

teams.title: Two teams take turns guessing cards
teams.text: One player gives clues while their team tries to guess the card's title
teams.info: Everyone has to take a turn giving clues before anyone goes twice.

turn.title: Each turn is 63 seconds long
turn.text: During a **turn**, the team in play guesses as many cards as they can
turn.info: The player giving clues holds the phone.

rounds.title: The game has 3 rounds
rounds.text: Each **round** is made up of many **turns**, and ends when every card in the deck has been guessed
rounds.info: All three rounds are played with the same deck.
rounds.more_info:
At the start of each round the deck is shuffled and played again.

Pay attention on your opponents' turns, as the cards they guess come back in later rounds.

round1.title: Round 1
round1.subtitle: Forbidden words
round1.text: Describe the card however you like, but you can't say any word from its title
round1.clue1: Christmas movie about being left solo in a house
round1.info: For "Home Alone", you can't say "home" or "alone".
round1.more_info:
Prepositions don't count as forbidden words.

If a forbidden word is said and the card is guessed, the other team can contest it and it's marked incorrect at the end of the turn.
round1.note_description: You can't use words from the card's title

round2.title: Round 2
round2.subtitle: One word only
round2.text: You can give just a single word as your clue, no sounds, no gestures
round2.info: Remember: every card was already revealed back in round 1.
round2.more_info:
To reach round 2, every card has to have been guessed in round 1.

The cards stay the same, but the clue-giver's job gets harder each round!
round2.note_description: You can only give one word clues.

round3.title: Round 3
round3.subtitle: Charades
round3.text: No words at all, only gestures and sounds!
round3.note_description: Words are forbidden, only gestures and sounds!

controls.guess_text: If your team guesses the card, press the guess button **CHECK_ICON**
controls.skip_text: Don't know what to say, or want a new card? Press **Skip**
controls.info: You can also mark cards guessed or skipped by swiping.
controls.more_info:
Swipe right to mark it guessed, left to skip. Skipped cards stay in the deck and come back later in the same round, so you'll get another shot.

In Classic mode skipping is free, so don't just watch the clock tick!

post_turn.summary_text: After your **turn** you'll see a summary of every card you guessed and skipped
post_turn.controls_text: You can toggle any card's result here if a rule was broken or there was a mistake during play
post_turn.note_description: Here you can toggle the result of the cards if you made a mistake or broke any rules during play.

end_turn.end_turn_text: Press **End turn** to pass play to the next team, then hand over the phone.
end_turn.round_text: The **current round**, and its rules, continue until every card in the deck has been guessed.
end_turn.info: Don't forget to end your turn before passing the phone!
end_turn.more_info: If you don't, the next player might see cards that were skipped this round and are still in play.

end_game.title: The game ends after round 3
end_game.subtitle: The team with the most points wins, but you already knew that!
